## Activity

During February 2022, Oakridge Primary Care recorded 49 captures. This provides the activity total for the reporting period and indicates that capture work was carried out at the site throughout the month. The recorded activity is presented without adjustment or additional interpretation.

## Image quality

Of the 49 captures, 1 was ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.0 per cent. This result identifies the proportion of captures that could not be assessed and should be considered alongside the overall activity recorded for Oakridge Primary Care. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

A total of 6 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 15 days. This records the central grading interval for the month and provides an indication of the time taken for results to progress through grading. The activity, image quality and grading measures together summarise site operations at Oakridge Primary Care during February 2022.
